1543101.name: Holy Grace
1543101.description: Fires an energy sphere, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1543103.name: Hallowed Trail
1543103.description: Fires a golden energy sphere, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The energy sphere can be intercepted.

1543105.name: Golden Crux
1543105.description: A golden cross emits a burst of light, dealing damage to the Nikke with the highest ATK.

1543107.name: Prayer
1543107.description: Discharges an energy wave, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1543109.name: Strongest Shield on the Surface
1543109.description: Altruia activates Saintess's Halos, which grant her increased ATK and invulnerability after a certain amount of time. Attacking the halos will cause them to deactivate, shortening the duration of her invulnerability according to the number deactivated.

1543111.name: Garden of Altruism
1543111.description: Emits a burst of energy, dealing lethal damage to all Nikkes.

1543112.name: Blessing
1543112.description:
Fires a ring-shaped energy beam, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while Cancel Rings are active. While the barrier is up, only Iron Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1543116.name: Penance
1543116.description: Altruia places a shield in front of herself, increasing her defense.
